name: Bandhan Bank Ltd
title: Bandhan Bank Ltd - 541153 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bandhan Q4FY26 shows EEB stress easing: slippages fell to INR 1,028 crore from 1,314 crore and credit cost 2% vs 3.3%, with NIM up to 6.2%, but ROA of 1.1% is still far from the 1.6-1.7% exit-FY27 target.

triggers.label: EEB slippages 1,314 → 1,028 crore
triggers.quote: Gross slippages at the bank level declined sharply to INR 1,028 crores in Q4 compared to INR 1,314 crores in the previous quarter.

triggers.label: ROA 1.6-1.7% exit FY27 held
triggers.quote: we will be working towards seeing how we can gradually keep on improving the ROA towards the guided level of between 1.6% to 1.7% ROA by the exit of FY27

triggers.label: RBI ECL transition ~INR 1,250 crore
triggers.quote: the transition that we expect is to be roughly around INR 1,250 crores

guidance.quote: towards the guided level of between 1.6% to 1.7% ROA by the exit of FY27
we do expect at least another 10 to 20 basis points of improvement over the next 2 to 3 quarters
our guidance, we have mentioned was between 1.6% to 1.7% by the exit of FY27
We are particularly aiming a growth of around 14% - 15% in the credit
we are expecting that the PSL cost would come down by almost 50% to what we have incurred in FY26

red_flags.label: Senior EEB risk officer resignation
red_flags.quote: if you can talk about your resignation

red_flags.label: Opex/ops cost spike and PSL cost

evasions.quote: The flow impact is still being computed. We don't have a number as of yet.
Option is neither closed nor we are following up also.
